title: Banda Singh Bahadur & Misls Recall Quiz

questions.q: What was the capital of the first sovereign Sikh state established by Banda Singh Bahadur?
questions.qPa: ਬੰਦਾ ਸਿੰਘ ਬਹਾਦਰ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸਥਾਪਿਤ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਸੁਤੰਤਰ ਸਿੱਖ ਰਾਜ ਦੀ ਰਾਜਧਾਨੀ ਕਿਹੜੀ ਸੀ?
questions.explanation: Banda Singh Bahadur made Lohgarh (formerly Mukhlisgarh) his capital.

questions.q: In which battle did Banda Singh Bahadur defeat and kill Wazir Khan?
questions.explanation: The Battle of Chappar Chiri in 1710 resulted in the defeat and death of Wazir Khan of Sirhind.

questions.q: Who abolished the Zamindari system and gave land rights to the tillers in Punjab?
questions.qPa: ਪੰਜਾਬ ਵਿੱਚ ਜ਼ਿਮੀਂਦਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਥਾ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਸਨੇ ਖਤਮ ਕੀਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਕਿਸਾਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਜ਼ਮੀਨ ਦੇ ਹੱਕ ਦਿੱਤੇ?
questions.explanation: Banda Singh Bahadur enacted historic land reforms by abolishing the Zamindari system.

questions.q: Who organized the fragmented Sikh forces into the Dal Khalsa in 1748?
questions.explanation: Nawab Kapur Singh organized the Dal Khalsa in 1748, dividing it into Buddha Dal and Taruna Dal.

questions.q: Which of the following Misls was initially the most powerful in the 18th century?
questions.explanation: The Bhangi Misl, founded by Chhajja Singh, was initially the most powerful and controlled Lahore and Amritsar.

questions.q: Who was the founder of the Sukerchakia Misl?
questions.qPa: ਸ਼ੁਕਰਚੱਕੀਆ ਮਿਸਲ ਦਾ ਮੋਢੀ ਕੌਣ ਸੀ?
questions.explanation: Charat Singh, the grandfather of Maharaja Ranjit Singh, founded the Sukerchakia Misl.

questions.q: The Taruna Dal primarily consisted of:
questions.explanation: The Taruna Dal consisted of young soldiers who were responsible for offensive operations.

questions.q: The Phulkian Misl included which of the following states?
questions.explanation: The Phulkian Misl comprised the territories that later became the princely states of Patiala, Nabha, and Jind.
